title: Modern Ribbed Organizer Tray
author: Sipowka
description:
Large minimalist organizer tray with a modern ribbed design.

Perfect for organizing cosmetics, perfumes, skincare products, jewelry or everyday accessories. The large base provides plenty of space while the ribbed walls give the tray a stylish and modern look.

Great for bathroom shelves, dressing tables, desks or general home organization.

**Size:**

225 × 185 × 65 mm

Designed to print without supports and compatible with most standard 3D printing materials such as PLA.

**Printing Notes**

Because of the large flat top surface, printing the top layer can sometimes be challenging. Lower infill densities may cause the top layer to sag or produce uneven lines.

In my tests, the best results were achieved with **40% Gyroid infill and 5 top layers**. Other infill patterns or lower densities may lead to visible gaps on the top surface.

If anyone finds a more efficient way to print this model with lower infill or better surface quality, feel free to share your suggestions.
